title: Comparative Siouan Dictionary
cite_as: Robert L. Rankin, Richard T. Carter, A. Wesley Jones, John E. Koontz, David S. Rood and Iren Hartmann (eds.) 2015. Comparative Siouan Dictionary. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology (https://csd.clld.org); clld app deposit v2026.11, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23924655.
repository: https://github.com/clld/csd (the app; the data is its database dump, csd.sql.gz)
kind_of_work: set-centric comparative dictionary of the Siouan-Catawba family: 1,204 entries over 37 languages and proto-languages, as a clld app's PostgreSQL dump (no CLDF release)
holder: the CSD's editors (Rankin, Carter, Jones, Koontz, Rood; Hartmann for the app)

curation.language_map: etc/languages.json (the dump's languages, listed in checks/cl-6/languages.csv, with etc/languages.reviewed.json)
